consequence.statement: Operators must upgrade sequentially one minor version at a time and be on a v1.20 version before upgrading to v2.0, so CRD migrations run at each minor release.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade sequentially through each v1 minor up to v1.20, then upgrade to v2.0.

assertion.statement: Upgrading to Crossplane v2.0 should be done from v1.20, going sequentially through each v1 minor version, because each minor upgrade migrates CRDs so the latest versions are stored.
